name: io.github.brntech/myotp
title: MyOTP.App
description: Send and verify one-time passcodes over SMS, WhatsApp and Telegram.

environmentVariables.name: MYOTP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: MyOTP.App API key, needed by every tool except create_account and get_topup_quote. No key yet? Start the server without it and call create_account to get one.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: MyOTP.App API key, sent per request so the hosted server never stores it. Omit it to call create_account or get_topup_quote, which need no key. Note: calls reach the MyOTP API from 108.61.176.199, so add that IP to your key's allowlist or every call returns 403.
